# Code of Conduct

[中文](https://github.com/FCLCQ/craftsman-nostalgia?tab=code-of-conduct-ov-file)

This repository only covers the pack itself: mod list, configuration, scripts, resource packs, documentation and the build script.

When discussing, point at the concrete issue and include versions, logs or reproduction steps. Personal attacks, discriminatory language, harassment, and unrelated political or religious arguments are not allowed.

Maintainers may close issues and pull requests that do not meet the above without prior warning.

Adapted from Contributor Covenant 2.1, https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/.
